name: Presence checklist (departure / arrival)
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Event-driven, read-only: when you leave or arrive (HA person entity),
check the house state and push anything that needs attention.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Webhook — POST /webhook/presence; fired by a Home Assistant automation
on person.you state change (home → not_home and back)
2. Execute Command — read-only checks via the existing client:
get_states; ..." — doors/windows open, lights left on, heating running
(reads auto-proceed under existing policy; NO writes from this flow)
3. IF anything flagged — ntfy push via scripts/notify.sh:
4. Turning things OFF stays a separate approval-gated home_control_write
(one-tap approve from the same notification via the scenes flow).
